title: DataClass
description: The one data class of One (C-19 data_class, M-7, PV-20). `kinds` names what sort of data it is; `sensitive` lists the PV-20 special-category codes it touches (empty when none). Combining data takes the union of both lists. The retention class is the separate C-19 field. C-19, M-7, PV-20.

kind.description: general: no personal data; personal: about a person; contact: contact details; financial: money, accounts or payments; location: place or position; communication: message or call content; one_time_code: a one-time code or verification secret

is_sensitive.description: Holds when the data class touches a PV-20 code
